chapter: From Pittsburgh to Maxine Sullivan: management and style
title: Making the two movies and the five songs she sang
summary: In both films she was just in the movie; the songs in 'St. Louis Blues' included 'Loch Lomond', and she did little else on set.

blocks.x: Okay. Oh, I also notices somewhere, since, again we talked about Hollywood. Since the mention of that movie just came up. I was reading somewhere that the two movies you made were made for different studios. Saint Louis Blues was made for Paramount and Going Places for Warner Brothers.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Was there any difference, you know, in the way the movies were made or your experiences that might be related to the fact that they were with two different companies?

Well, you see in both instances I was just in the movie. They call it 'spots'. And although I was on the set of Saint Louis Blues longer than I was at Warner Brothers because I think I probably only worked at Warner Brothers about two weeks. But Saint Louis Blues was one of those kinds of movies of which was written, I think, on a day to day basis. And since it was my first movie they made a spot for me and as the movie progressed they found different places to put me, you know, sort of incidental, because I did five numbers in Saint Louis Blues, which originally I suppose, if they had thought about it in the first place I would have just done probably 'Loch Lomond' and 'Saint Louis Blues'.
Do you know exactly what the five songs were? I don't believe we have a list.
Well, 'Loch Lomond', 'Ochicura'(?), 'Saint Louis Blues', Hoggy Carmichael wrote 'Kind of

"Lonesome" for the movie. It's done, sort of, in the background. And I'm trying to think of the other one. Oh, I know, there was a repeat of the "Saint Louis Blues". But I mean I had these five different spots in the movie.
Yes, because I know we discussed several of those individually but we did not have a listing of everything.
Okay, so in a sense you just went on the set, performed like any other performance?
You didn't have that much of an involvement?
